Needs changes before merge. One required evidence item remains. I found no source defect.

The 22 router tools have consistent metric dimensions and exact inch conversions. The surfacing tools cannot plunge. All 33 legacy definitions remain unchanged. The import test checks the definitions, undo and redo.

I checked the current laws from `upstream/main` at `6fafa4e1fff0dfea45b92c0a691f823e8b4f6cfc`. The trial merge was clean; main was already an ancestor. All commands ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3159`. No GitHub runner was used.

Results:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | Passed: 101 tools tests and 15 app tests |
| `cargo clippy -j 32 -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` | Passed: 236 steps, 0 failed, 38 minutes |
| Motion heavy lane | 59 tests passed; 2 known-fail checks matched #1950 |
| App heavy lane | 43 tests passed; 4 known-fail checks matched #1950 and #2849 |
| `git diff --check upstream/main` | Passed |

Extra suites run:

- `cargo test -j 32 -p camcraft-tools --test waterjet`: 6 passed. This suite also reads the changed catalog asset.
- No importer, fixture or golden directory changed. The extra kernel STEP suites do not apply.

Safety review and mutations:

The added cutter dimensions affect machining geometry. I used the safety review tier. No G-code, CLFile, snapshot or other golden changed.

- I restored the upstream catalog. The new tools test failed: `left: 0`, `right: 22`. It passed after restoration.
- I restored the upstream catalog. The new app import test failed: `left: 0`, `right: 22`. It passed after restoration.
- I changed the 1/8 inch up-cut tool's exposed shank length from 13 to 14 mm. The tools test rejected the incorrect 26 mm reach. It passed after restoration.
- I set the 25 mm surfacing tool's `center_cutting` field to `true`. The tools test failed with `Router surfacing 25 mm cannot plunge`. It passed after restoration.

The catalog asset now matches the PR head exactly. No mutation remains.

Requested before merge:

1. **PR body, Tests; change anchor `crates/tools/src/catalog_asset_tests.rs:34`: record the required heavy-lane results.** The planner selects both the motion and app heavy lanes for this change. The body lists only quick tests and clippy. Current upstream `AGENTS.md`, “Heavy lanes at review,” requires the body to name the lanes that ran. Add the heavy command, both lanes, and the results above. This review supplies the local results on the unchanged final head. No source change is needed. After the body update, add a comment that identifies this evidence fix so the same head can receive a new review.

Notes: No `crates/ui` file changed, so before/after screenshots are not required. The GUI and a real machine were not exercised. The nominal assembly dimensions and baseline feeds still need a check against the actual machine and tool.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: The PR body now records the required heavy-lane results in Tests.

- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: 236 steps passed, 0 failed, 38 minutes.
- Motion heavy lane: 59 tests passed. Two known-fail checks matched #1950.
- App heavy lane: 43 tests passed. Four known-fail checks matched #1950 and #2849.

The [latest review](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3159#issuecomment-7063067027) supplies these local results on the unchanged head.
I verified the updated body. No source change or new mutation check was required.
The existing pins are `catalog_asset_tests::router_starter_tools_state_their_shapes_and_reach` and `router_starter_library_imports_without_refusals_and_undoes_as_one_unit`.
The review records their RED/GREEN mutation checks.

The quick gate passed again: 2 steps, 0 failed.
Clippy passed for `camcraft-tools` and `camcraft-app`, with all targets and `-D warnings`.
`git diff --check upstream/main` passed.

Head: `5bb177e5247ad6ebc3bc4148bd1935a63d6934ec` (unchanged).
The plain push reported `Everything up-to-date`.
Please re-review this evidence fix on the same head.

Ready for the maintainer to merge. No blocking findings remain.

This is a review of the evidence update on the same head. The later `Addressed` comment permits this review. The PR body now names the heavy command, both reached lanes, and their results. This meets the earlier request.

The 22 router tools have consistent metric dimensions and exact inch conversions. The surfacing tools cannot plunge. All 33 legacy catalog rows remain identical and retain their relative order. The app test checks import, definitions, undo and redo.

I checked the current laws from `upstream/main` at `c2423f1703f706bb3a6a9e98bd206fd1b96b5bd0`. The trial merge was clean. The following checks ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3159`, on that merged tree. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | Passed: 101 tools tests and 15 app tests; 2 steps, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -j 32 -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |
| `git diff --check upstream/main` | Passed |

Extra suites run:

- `cargo test -j 32 -p camcraft-tools --test waterjet`: 6 passed. This suite also reads the catalog asset.
- No fixture, golden directory or importer changed. The extra kernel STEP suites do not apply.

Heavy-lane evidence:

The [earlier review](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3159#issuecomment-7063067027) records a local heavy run on this unchanged PR head. The body now includes those results. I checked that evidence; I did not repeat the heavy run during this review.

- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: 236 steps passed, 0 failed.
- Motion heavy lane: 59 tests passed. Two known-fail checks matched #1950.
- App heavy lane: 43 tests passed. Four known-fail checks matched #1950 and #2849.

Safety review and mutations:

The cutter dimensions affect machining geometry. I used the safety review tier. No G-code, CLFile, snapshot or other golden changed.

I repeated two mutations against `catalog_asset_tests::router_starter_tools_state_their_shapes_and_reach`:

1. Change the 1/8 inch up-cut tool's exposed shank length from 13 to 14 mm. RED: the test rejected the 26 mm reach. Restore the asset. GREEN: the test passed.
2. Set the 25 mm surfacing tool's `center_cutting` field to `true`. RED: the test failed with `Router surfacing 25 mm cannot plunge`. Restore the asset. GREEN: the test passed.

The catalog matches the reviewed tree again. No mutation remains.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes: No `crates/ui` file changed, so screenshots are not required. The GUI and a real machine were not exercised. Check the nominal assembly dimensions and baseline feeds against the actual tool and machine before machining.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
Merge: the coordinator merges head 5bb177e52 on mkinney's pr-reviewer marker on this head (Ready) and the merge-ready label. The coordinator added the label P4 of #3069.
